lines.text: In this lesson, you will learn to play notes and melodies with the music blocks, using note numbers, beats and loops for rhythms.
Going up by 2 gives the next white key: 60 C, 62 D, 64 E, 65 F, 67 G, 69 A, 71 B, 72 high C.
Play notes one after another to make a tune.
The order matters, just like any script!
A beat is a unit of time in music.
1 beat is a long note, 0.5 beats is quicker, 0.25 is very quick.
Use repeat to play a pattern again and again — that’s a rhythm or a riff.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now build along, then try the challenges. You’ve got this!
